ok so we planned portugal like for months. me and her. it was gonna be our thing, we even had a whole pinterest board lol. and then she just. she texted me she's going with becca instead. like a group thing now apparently. and i found out the actual dates were already booked. without me

honestly more hurt i think. like im not even that mad? i keep waiting to be mad. its more like. i thought i mattered more than that. we've been friends since we were 11. and becca's known her two years. and somehow im the one getting cut. that part stings
Yeah, that sting sounds like being cut out after expecting to be chosen. Does it feel more like a hollow ache, wanting to pull away, or something else?

yeah the hollow thing. kinda. i havent texted back yet. its been like a day. i dont even know what id say. part of me wants to act like its no big deal so she doesnt think im being dramatic. ugh. i hate that this is getting to me this much over a trip
That hollow, holding-back feeling makes sense here — and it sounds like the trip touched something bigger than the trip itself. If you want, we can stay with that, or leave it here for now.

yeah maybe its the choosing part more than the trip. like who picks me. i didnt expect to say that out loud honestly. i think i should probably just sit with it tonight. but. this was less weird than i thought it'd be. thanks i guess
